rows.text: when `edx` is 0 or less (signed) tail-jumps to `001DBF00(1, 0, ecx, r8d)`; otherwise makes the call at `002DF1E0` + 0x2C with (1, 0, `ecx`, `edx`, `r8d` as the fifth stack argument) and returns its result

returns 0 when `rcx` is null or dword `[rcx]` is -1; otherwise, when word `[rcx]` is not `0xffff`, forms the record at qword `022C6F28` + sign-extended word * 0x740 and, when that pointer is non-null and its dword `+0x284` is non-zero, calls `00426E20` on it; returns 1 on every path past the first guard

does nothing when `ecx` is above 0x1f (unsigned); otherwise, when qword slot `02B5EA20[ecx]` (stride 8) is non-null, calls `003EB470` on it and clears the slot, then stores into the slot, and returns, the result of the call at `003EB190` + 0x52 with (`rdx`, `r8d`, `r9d`, the fifth (stack) argument)
calls `00466C40(ecx)`, then the call at `00473490` + 0x17 with the same `ecx`, and returns in `xmm0` the second float minus the first
calls `00466BB0(ecx)`, then `00466C40(ecx)`, and returns in `xmm0` the first float minus the second
